# ReCaptured

> ReCaptured is one connected system for running a business of 3 to 25 people. Leads, deals, projects, people, files, meetings and chat live on a single record, and an AI assistant works from that record and nothing else. One login, one bill, from $69 per seat. Operated by RECAPTURED, LLC (Wilmington, DE, USA).

## What ReCaptured is

Small teams run the business out of a CRM, a project tool, a chat app, a drive and a meeting recorder, each with its own login, bill and version of the truth. ReCaptured replaces that stack with one system of record. Everything that touches the business (a web form, an email, a Slack thread, a meeting, a dictated note, a file) becomes part of a record, stays linked to its source, and becomes something the assistant can answer about. Built-in agents triage intake, draft tasks from meeting transcripts, watch deadlines and SLAs, and propose who should do what next; a person approves each one. Anything that leaves the organization waits for a person to confirm. Private and Off-the-Record content is never indexed.

## Who it's for

Teams of 3 to 25 who want one system instead of six. Served today: construction and contracting, field services and trades, nonprofits and member organizations, professional services, agencies, sales teams and multi-entity organizations. Golf, boat and member clubs, restaurants and hospitality are in pilot. Larger teams are welcome to talk; the honest answer on fit comes on the call.

## Pricing

$69 per full seat per month, 3-seat minimum, billed monthly, cancel any time from account settings. Every module is included; no add-ons. External guests (clients, vendors, board members) are free and view-only, scoped to what you share. Founding 100: the first 100 paying customers keep their per-seat price for 24 months. Pilots: 30 days on your own data for industries ReCaptured is actively building for, no usage charges.

## The AI assistant

Answers from your records and cites the source; follows the screen you're on; drafts tasks from transcripts; triages intake with its reasoning shown; guards deadlines and SLAs; proposes workload rebalances; captures decisions from chat; drafts replies and briefs; enriches company facts from public and connected sources with candidates for you to choose; learns your organization's vocabulary. Connect ChatGPT or Claude to your records through MCP, per organization, with an admin choosing which tools are exposed. It never changes records or sends anything outside the organization without a person's approval. Customer records are not used to train AI models.

## Security and data

Multi-factor authentication required for every account, with Google or Microsoft sign-in. Role-based access with a full audit log, including a log of every ReCaptured operator access. Files are malware-scanned before anything can read them. Meeting recording asks every participant for consent and time-stamps it. Export your data any time in standard formats; if you leave, export for 30 days and deletion within 90 days after that. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are on the roadmap, not held today. Hosted in the United States (us-east-1).
